numeric_corroboration: independently confirmed by direct mpmath integration (40 dps) of boundary-seeded trajectories on both branches, both w endpoints, both sides: every trajectory stays inside the tube until |K| exits the domain. This corroborates but does not replace the exact interval proof.
proof_method: boundary sign conditions reduced to exact rational polynomials (denominators 2(3w+5)^6(9w+7)^3 proven positive on the box; the lowest K-power factored exactly), then proven UNIFORMLY by monomial-wise exact-Fraction interval bounds with conclusive branch-and-bound bisection (max depth 14; an inconclusive result fails closed — grid sampling is never accepted as proof).
statement: the tube |Sigma - (kappa K + c2 K^2)| <= M |K|^3 is forward invariant for the registered reduced flow WHILE |K| stays in the compact domain (both branches): on each Sigma-boundary curve the field points inward, so a trajectory can leave only through the |K| = k_abs_max faces. No bound is claimed once |K| exits the domain (|K| grows on both branches).
transient_note: the certificate bounds trajectories seeded inside the trap; the PR-131 slaved trajectories (linear seed, K0 = 1e-8) are verified in-trap at every recorded FD probe via the cross-artifact check.
